topicName: Physical Backups using Percona XtraBackup / MySQL Enterprise Backup
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Physical Backups in MySQL using Percona XtraBackup"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Physical backups are critical for enterprise-grade MySQL database management. Unlike logical backups generated by mysqldump, physical backups copy the actual underlying database files (data files, logs, and indexes). This approach delivers significantly faster backup and restore times for large datasets."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Tools Overview"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Percona XtraBackup is an open-source, hot backup utility for MySQL that performs non-blocking backups for InnoDB and Percona XtraDB tables. MySQL Enterprise Backup is the official Oracle counterpart offering similar capabilities."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Root or sudo access to the database server host."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Installed Percona XtraBackup matching your MySQL major version."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A dedicated database user with RELOAD, LOCK TABLES, REPLICATION CLIENT, and PROCESS privileges."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Creating a Full Backup"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"To take a full physical backup, use the xtrabackup tool, pointing it to your data directory and supplying your database credentials."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"xtrabackup --backup --target-dir=/data/backups/base --user=backup_user --password=secure_password"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"During this process, XtraBackup copies the InnoDB data files, reads the transaction log, and tracks changes. The database remains fully operational for read and write transactions."},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Preparing the Backup"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"Before restoring, the backup must be prepared. This step applies the transaction logs to the data files so that the database is in a consistent state (crash recovery phase)."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"xtrabackup --prepare --target-dir=/data/backups/base"},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 3: Restoring the Backup"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"To restore the physical backup, stop the MySQL server, ensure the target data directory is completely empty, and copy the files back."},{"order":17,"type":"code","text":"sudo systemctl stop mysql
rm -rf /var/lib/mysql/*
xtrabackup --copy-back --target-dir=/data/backups/base"},{"order":18,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 4: Fixing Permissions and Starting MySQL"},{"order":19,"type":"paragraph","text":"Because files copied via XtraBackup inherit the permissions of the user executing the command, you must restore the correct ownership to the MySQL system user."},{"order":20,"type":"code","text":"sudo chown -R mysql:mysql /var/lib/mysql
sudo systemctl start mysql"},{"order":21,"type":"paragraph","text":"Your MySQL server is now successfully restored and operational from the physical backup."}]
